sections.title: Main Quest
sections.note: 18 Main Quests in the Adventure Log, split into steps. Gerudo/Jabul and Eldin/Hebra/Faron can be done in any order.

items.name: Prologue: Link vs. Ganon
items.howTo: Play as Link through the opening area and defeat Ganon to free Zelda; Link is then swallowed by a rift.
items.notes: Boss: Ganon (played as Link).

items.name: The Mysterious Rifts: escape the castle
items.howTo: Tri gives Zelda the Tri Rod in her cell. Use Echoes (Old Bed, Table, etc.) to escape the dungeon, meet Impa and get away through the Royal-Family Shortcut.
items.reward: Tri Rod; Disguise outfit; Impa's map
items.notes: Main Quest 'The Mysterious Rifts' (giver: Impa).

items.name: The Mysterious Rifts: Suthorn Forest rift
items.area: Stilled Suthorn Forest (rift by Lueburry's House)
items.howTo: Wake in the Suthorn Beach cave, cross Suthorn Prairie and Forest to Lueburry's House, then enter the rift at its eastern edge and push through the Stilled Suthorn Forest to the Suthorn Ruins.
items.notes: Sub-boss: Zol x5 in the Stilled Suthorn Forest.

items.name: Suthorn Ruins (dungeon)
items.howTo: Clear the first dungeon. Tri teaches Bind and Reverse Bond; take the Mysterious Sword left by the Link impostor to unlock Swordfighter Form.
items.reward: Heart Container; 5 Might Crystals; Sword of Might (Swordfighter Form); Tri Lv. 2
items.notes: Sub-boss: Link (Still World impostor) and Deku Baba x3. Boss: Seismic Talus. Chest: Heart Pin accessory.

items.name: The Mysterious Rifts: meet Lueburry
items.howTo: Follow Minister Lefte to Lueburry's House. Tri marks the large rifts in the Gerudo Desert and Jabul Waters.
items.notes: Completes The Mysterious Rifts. Gerudo Desert and Jabul Waters can be done in either order.

items.name: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert: Gerudo Town
items.howTo: Head west to the desert. Ask the soldier at the sand-buried Gerudo Sanctum, help Captain Dohna, see Chief Seera at the palace in Gerudo Town, then meet Dohna at the Oasis.
items.notes: Main Quest 'A Rift in the Gerudo Desert' (starts on entering the desert).

items.name: Southern Oasis Ruins Rift
items.howTo: Defeat the monsters pouring from the small rift to relieve the exhausted Gerudo soldiers.
items.notes: Main Quest; one of three small-rift tasks from Dohna, any order.

items.name: Ancestor's Cave of Rest Rift
items.howTo: Get past the rift inside the cave and relight the torches at the grave site.
items.notes: Main Quest; one of three small-rift tasks from Dohna, any order.

items.name: Southern Gerudo Desert Rift
items.howTo: Give two Chilly Cactus to the Oasis Smoothie Shop for a Cactus Smoothie and bring it to the parched soldiers.
items.notes: Main Quest (giver: Dohna); one of three small-rift tasks, any order.

items.name: Gerudo Desert: the warriors' rift
items.howTo: After reporting to the palace, follow Chief Seera and Dohna to the grown rift in the east, enter it and rescue Tri's friends and the swallowed warriors. The impostor Facette is exposed.

items.name: Gerudo Desert: unplug the Sanctum
items.howTo: With Seera's permission, go through the cave in the southern desert and remove the plug so Gerudo Sanctum rises from the sand.
items.notes: Sub-boss: Aruroda.

items.name: Gerudo Sanctum (dungeon)
items.howTo: Enter the rift inside the Sanctum and clear the dungeon to mend the Gerudo Desert rift.
items.reward: Heart Container; 5 Might Crystals; Bow of Might
items.notes: Sub-bosses: Mothula, Poe, Link (Still World). Boss: Mogryph.

items.name: The Jabul Waters Rift: the Zora chiefs
items.area: Seesyde Village / Zora villages / Crossflows Plaza
items.howTo: Learn in Seesyde Village that Lord Jabu-Jabu is rampaging. Visit the Sea Zora (Kushara) and River Zora (Dradd) chiefs and follow them to Crossflows Plaza, where Jabu-Jabu swallows two Zora.
items.notes: Main Quest 'The Jabul Waters Rift' (giver: Tri).

items.name: Chaos at River Zora Village
items.howTo: Go to River Zora Village, find Kushara, then enter the small rift that swallowed Dradd and other River Zora and free Tri's friends.
items.notes: Main Quest.

items.name: Rampage in Zora Cove
items.area: Cave on the small island in Zora Cove
items.howTo: Find another way into the island cave where Kushara and a Zora child are trapped, then Bind away the rocks blocking the exit.
items.notes: Main Quest. Chiefs make up afterwards.

items.name: Lord Jabu-Jabu's Den
items.howTo: Restore the den (Bind the golden platform, clear boulders) so both chiefs can play, then defeat the impostor Lord Jabu-Jabu (feed it Bombfish or let it inhale its own spawn).
items.notes: Sub-boss: impostor Lord Jabu-Jabu.

items.name: Jabul Ruins (dungeon)
items.howTo: Enter the large rift Tri opens, cross the Stilled Jabul Waters and clear the Jabul Ruins to free the real Lord Jabu-Jabu.
items.reward: Heart Container; 5 Might Crystals; General Wright rescued
items.notes: Sub-bosses: Sand Crab x5; Biri x2 + Tangler x5; Tektite x4. Boss: Vocavor.

items.name: Still Missing: Castle Town rift
items.area: Hyrule Castle Town / Bottom of the Well
items.howTo: Report to Lueburry's House, follow General Wright to Hyrule Castle Town, which is swallowed by a giant rift. Enter the rift from the bottom of the well (Trampoline Echo) behind the last house on the left.
items.after: After both the Gerudo Desert and Jabul Waters rifts
items.notes: Main Quest 'Still Missing' (giver: Tri). Completes 'Searching for Everyone'.

items.name: Hyrule Castle (dungeon)
items.area: Stilled Hyrule Castle Town / Hyrule Castle
items.howTo: Climb through the Stilled Hyrule Castle Town to the castle and clear it to rescue the King.
items.notes: Sub-bosses: Darknut, Darknut Lv. 2, Ball-and-Chain Trooper. Boss: Ganon (an Echo). Chest: Frog Ring accessory. Afterwards the King gives 'Lands of the Goddesses' and 'Rescuing the Hero Link' and Zelda receives the Royal Travel Attire.

items.name: The Rift on Eldin Volcano: Goron City
items.howTo: Climb the Eldin Volcano Trail north of Kakariko Village to Goron City and enter the rift that swallowed Chief Darston and other Gorons.
items.notes: Main Quest 'The Rift on Eldin Volcano'. Eldin, Hebra and Faron can be done in any order.

items.name: Rock-Roast Quarry
items.howTo: Find Elder Gol, fetch rock roast from deeper in the quarry and bring it back to him.
items.notes: Main Quest; order with Lizalfos Burrow is free.

items.name: Lizalfos Burrow
items.howTo: Help Elder Silv by defeating the dark Lizalfos deeper in the burrow.
items.notes: Main Quest. Sub-boss: Lizalfos Lv. 2.

items.name: The Rift on Eldin Volcano: Crater Shortcut
items.howTo: Back in Goron City, Bind the screw on the old chief's portrait to open the Crater Shortcut, follow Darston to the crater and enter the rift.

items.name: Eldin Temple (dungeon)
items.howTo: Clear the Eldin Temple to mend the Eldin Volcano rift.
items.reward: Heart Container; 5 Might Crystals; Bombs of Might; Din's Sanction
items.notes: Sub-bosses: Link (Still World), Fire Wizzrobe. Boss: Volvagia.

items.name: Rift on Holy Mount Lanayru: reach Hebra
items.area: Hebra Mountain Passage (cave north of Hyrule Castle Town)
items.howTo: Blow open the blocked cave north of Castle Town (bomb Echo), cross the Hebra Mountain Passage, then find Condé in the blizzard and follow him to his house.
items.notes: Main Quest 'Rift on Holy Mount Lanayru' starts when you reach Hebra Mountain.

items.name: Rift on Holy Mount Lanayru: cave rift
items.area: Stilled Hebra Mountain Cave (cave next to Condé's House)
items.howTo: In the cave beside Condé's House, melt ice with fire Echoes, find Condé shovelling snow into a rift and enter the rift in the room to the left.

items.name: Rift on Holy Mount Lanayru: the summit
items.area: Hebra Mountain peak / Stilled Hebra Mountain / Stilled Holy Mount Lanayru
items.howTo: Climb through the caves to the peak (Ice Wizzrobe Echo helps), follow Condé's brother's footprints north into the rift and climb the Stilled Holy Mount Lanayru.

items.name: Lanayru Temple (dungeon)
items.area: Stilled Holy Mount Lanayru / Lanayru Temple
items.howTo: Enter the building at the top of the Stilled Holy Mount Lanayru and clear the temple.
items.reward: Heart Container; 5 Might Crystals; Nayru's Sanction
items.notes: Sub-bosses: Ice Octo x2, Slime Eye, Temper Tweelus x4, White Wolfos. Boss: Skorchill.

items.name: A Rift in the Faron Wetlands: membership card
items.area: Scrubton / Heart Lake / Stilled Blossu's House / Deku Scrub Lockup
items.howTo: The Sweet Spot needs a membership card. Follow leads to Heart Lake and the East Ruins, find Blossu in the south and mend the rift over their house; you are arrested, escape the Deku Scrub Lockup (Tri Rod confiscated, then recovered) and get Blossu's card.
items.notes: Main Quest 'A Rift in the Faron Wetlands'.

items.name: A Rift in the Faron Wetlands: The Sweet Spot
items.area: The Sweet Spot / Stilled Faron Wetlands
items.howTo: Show the card at The Sweet Spot (northeast), defeat the monsters inside and enter the rift that swallowed the Deku Scrubs.

items.name: Faron Temple (dungeon)
items.howTo: Cross the Stilled Faron Wetlands to the Faron Temple and clear it.
items.reward: Heart Container; 5 Might Crystals; Farore's Sanction
items.notes: Sub-bosses: Baby Gohma + Electric Wizzrobe; Manhandla. Boss: Gohma.

items.name: The Prime Energy and Null: Eternal Forest
items.howTo: Go northwest of Hyrule Castle into the Eternal Forest. Learn the Ancient Orb Echo at the stone monument, crown all six pedestals, then meet the Deku Tree and enter the Ancient Ruins.
items.notes: Main Quest 'The Prime Energy and Null' (giver: King of Hyrule). Completes 'Lands of the Goddesses'.

items.name: Rescuing the Hero Link
items.howTo: Enter the rift in the Ancient Ruins, defeat the echo of Zelda and free Link from his crystal with the Bow of Might.
items.notes: Boss: echo of Zelda (internal name Tekom). Completes Main Quest 'Rescuing the Hero Link'.

items.name: Null's Body (final dungeon)
items.area: Null's Body (beyond the Stilled Ancient Ruins)
items.howTo: Give Link back his weapons and confirm 'I'm ready' to enter; work through the dungeon with Link's help.
items.notes: Point of no return per Game8: stock Damage Reduction smoothies (e.g. Golden Tough Smoothie) before talking to Link.

items.name: Final boss: Null
items.howTo: Defeat Null across three phases (the second is an underwater side-scrolling chase), then Bind the Prime Energy out of its core and mash A.
items.notes: Completes 'The Prime Energy and Null'. Post-game: the Deku Tree in the Eternal Forest tells you how many Echoes you are missing per region.

items.name: Tri Rod
items.howTo: Tri creates it and lends it to Zelda in her prison cell.
items.reward: Learn and summon Echoes (Tri Lv. 1: 3 triangles)

items.name: Bind
items.howTo: Tri teaches it at the boulder blocking the path inside the Suthorn Ruins.
items.reward: Move objects, enemies and Echoes with Zelda

items.name: Reverse Bond
items.howTo: Tri teaches it later in the Suthorn Ruins: hold R while Binding.
items.reward: Zelda follows the movement of what she is bound to

items.name: Tri's Power level
items.howTo: Tri levels up by mending rifts, large and small. Small rifts also open through side quests (Impa's Gift, From the Heart, Stamp Stand Swallowed!).
items.notes: Max is Lv. 11; the 6-triangle cap comes at Lv. 9. Exact rift counts per level are not published. Cost-reduction lists differ slightly between Zelda Wiki and Game8 (e.g. Sword Moblin at Lv. 5 vs Lv. 4).

tiers.name: Lv. 2
tiers.howTo: Mend the Suthorn Forest rift (Suthorn Ruins)

tiers.name: Lv. 3
tiers.reward: Summon Echoes at a distance (hold Y)

tiers.name: Lv. 4
tiers.reward: -1 cost for 14 Echoes (e.g. Spear Moblin, Darknut, Gibdo, Caromadillo, Deku Baba, Tektite)

tiers.name: Lv. 5
tiers.reward: -1 cost for 14 Echoes (e.g. Ignizol, Hydrozol, Club Boarblin, ReDead, Tornando, Crow)

tiers.name: Lv. 7
tiers.reward: -1 cost for 14 Echoes (e.g. Lizalfos, Armos, Wolfos, Mothula, Peahat, Spark)

tiers.name: Lv. 8
tiers.reward: -1 cost for 14 Echoes (e.g. Fire Octo, Ice Octo, Zirro, Poe, Leever, Platboom)

tiers.name: Lv. 10
tiers.reward: -1 cost for 14 Echoes (e.g. Buzz Blob, Torch Slug, Tweelus, Freezard, Beamos)

tiers.name: Lv. 11
tiers.reward: -1 cost for 13 Echoes (e.g. Lynel, Darknut Lv. 3, the three Wizzrobes, Beakon)

sections.title: Swordfighter Form
sections.note: Weapon levels and the Energy gauge are bought from Lueburry with Might Crystals (tracked with the Might Crystals).

items.name: Sword of Might (Swordfighter Form)
items.howTo: Pick up the Mysterious Sword left behind by the Link impostor in the Suthorn Ruins.
items.reward: Swordfighter Form, powered by Energy from the Still World

items.name: Bow of Might
items.howTo: Treasure Chest inside the Gerudo Sanctum.

items.name: Bombs of Might
items.howTo: Treasure Chest inside the Eldin Temple.
